content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To pick tap dance shoes, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Look up local dance supply stores (10 minutes)
Step 2. Compare the leather quality of top choices (20 minutes)
Step 3. Research different tap plate materials (1 hour)
Step 4. Determine your budget range (5 minutes)
Step 5. Make the final purchase (10 minutes)
Step 6. Check the return policy for the shoes (5 minutes)
Step 7. Inquire about the warranty on the taps (10 minutes)
Step 8. Read reviews on heel stability (30 minutes)
Step 9. Ask a dance teacher for brand recommendations (15 minutes)
Step 10. Measure your foot length and width (5 minutes)
Step 11. Check online availability for specific sizes (15 minutes)
Step 12. Look for seasonal discount codes (10 minutes)
Step 13. Call the store to confirm stock (5 minutes)
Step 14. Watch video reviews of the sound quality (45 minutes)
Step 15. Decide between split-sole or full-sole (20 minutes)
Step 16. Examine the cushioning of the insole (10 minutes)
Step 17. Select a preferred color (5 minutes)
Step 18. Verify the screw tightness on floor models (5 minutes)
Step 19. Drive to the dance supply shop (30 minutes)
Step 20. Browse the physical display shelves (15 minutes)
Step 21. Ask a sales associate for assistance (5 minutes)
Step 22. Inspect the stitching on the toe box (10 minutes)
Step 23. Try on a pair of Capezio shoes (15 minutes)
Step 24. Read about the difference between Teletone and Duo-Tone taps (40 minutes)
Step 25. Compare the weight of different models (15 minutes)
Step 26. Check for any ankle rubbing (10 minutes)
Step 27. Test the flexibility of the arch (5 minutes)
Step 28. Research high-top vs. low-cut styles (30 minutes)
Step 29. Compare the resonance of the metal plates (20 minutes)
Step 30. Look for professional dancer endorsements (1 hour)
Step 31. Narrow down the search to three brands (15 minutes)
Step 32. Perform a basic shuffle to test the weight (5 minutes)
Step 33. Try on a pair of Bloch shoes (15 minutes)
Step 34. Check the thickness of the sole (10 minutes)
Step 35. Decide on the desired heel height (10 minutes)
Step 36. Confirm if the taps are pre-installed (5 minutes)
Step 37. Read a blog post on professional tap fitting (25 minutes)
Step 38. Walk around the store to check for pinching (10 minutes)
Step 39. Evaluate the lacing system (5 minutes)
Step 40. Perform a time step to hear the crispness (5 minutes)
Step 41. Try on a pair of Miller & Ben shoes (15 minutes)
Step 42. Compare the aesthetic style of the final two (10 minutes)
Step 43. Locate the checkout counter (2 minutes)
Step 44. Ask about a student discount (5 minutes)
Step 45. Double-check the size on the box (2 minutes)
Step 46. Ensure the leather is free of scuffs (5 minutes)
Step 47. Check your current sock thickness (2 minutes)
Step 48. Investigate synthetic vs. leather uppers (35 minutes)
Step 49. Inspect the grip of the non-slip pad (5 minutes)
Step 50. Consult a sizing chart for international brands (10 minutes)
